(WPEC)Comment on this story0CommentShare storySharetopics: Full moonPink moonApril 1MoonriseMoonsetWildflowersBlue moon2026WEST PALM BEACH, Fla (CBS12) — The April Full Moon will be visible on Wednesday night, April 1. The Pink Moon will be full at 10:12 p.m. and should easily be visible in the night sky. The April Full moon is visible tonight. (WPEC)Powered By 10 Sec Educators crowd board meeting, oppose salary impasse hearing plan NextStayThe moon won't actually be pink. It's named after pink wildflowers that bloom in the spring. The moon will rise tonight at 7:29 p.m. and set Thursday morning at 7:14 a.m. Our next full moon is Friday, May 1, 2026. This year, we have 13 full moons, with a blue moon occurring on May 31, 2026. There are 13 full moons this year.
